name: Ueshima Miko
source: A doctor who is regarded as everyone's older sister. She keeps up a clinic called Rescue Center in which the Chishiki Girls can purify themselves from blood, decrease their madness gauge and get their wounds treated. She is always ready to listen and give advice to anyone in need of. She's also fond of working with the professor on his research of the Jail.
